title: Qualify streamed exact-quota shuffle adapters at 40 GiB
question: Does the 2 GiB streaming adapter resource benefit transfer at 40 GiB within the same strict memory scope?
summary: qsvlite stream completes the 40 GiB job in 710.569 s, down 11.95% versus file staging with lower file counters and +21.40% process CPU. Opt-in Chopper takes 551.724 s in the prior qualification. The DuckDB stream reports engine allocation denial at m256.

workloads: 40 GiB plain fixed-width CSV, exact 8 parts, 1 GiB hard cgroup with swap disabled and one requested worker per command.

validation.summary: Complete exact field/ID/quotas/caps/nonidentity checks for all finished workloads. Preflights and the failed full DuckDB attempt are retained.

limitations: Only one full job per completed tool variant in WSL2/ext4. Backing caches uncontrolled.
DuckDB failure describes the exact mixed-tool pipeline and engine setting. It does not establish a general DuckDB bound. Individual RSS and cgroup cache peaks have separate scope.
exclusions: Small preflights and failed attempts. Fixture hashing and independent oracle outside clocks.
